newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar futures set June volume record.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar futures set June volume record.

text.p: Trading in white sugar futures on the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) set a new monthly record in July of 72,813 contracts, LIFFE said in a statement.
The previous monthly record for white sugar futures was 71,059 contracts, set in April 1997. The June volume for white sugar futures amounted to 58,523 contracts.
The overall futures volume in commodity products totalled 346,193 contracts in July, up from the 313,409 posted for June.
Cocoa accounted for the largest volume by product with 154,363 contracts traded compared with 228,615 the previous month.
Robusta coffee attracted less trading interest in the month. In July 102,618 contracts changed hands, down from the 152,217 in June.
Coffee dominated the July options volume, accounting for 16,156 contracts of the total 18,517 traded. In June coffee options accounted for 15,719 of a total 20,001.
